text: Completed the remaining infrastructure. Explicit homepage and SCM metadata now point at canardlapin/slurm4s; Apache-2.0, developer metadata, sbt-typelevel release publication, fatal warnings, and the Scala/JDK matrix were already present. The generated workflow is current (including batch/task target artifacts). The optional dependency-submission job was removed after repeated 403s rather than granting every test job repository write access. The pre-baseline MiMa step was removed because mimaPreviousArtifacts is empty; P7.6 owns enabling and mutation-proving that gate after the first baseline exists. tools/acceptance/v1-local-gate.sh now runs +test, +publishLocal, and worker/packageBin. docs/release.md records the procedure and pre-baseline boundary. Full gate passed on Scala 3.3.8 and 3.8.4 with 516 tests per lane and all publishable artifacts written locally.
